content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The set-backed resolution rule names the same four outcomes as the file-backed rule and forbids a per-target read; the license check reads the crossing invariant, S2-resolve's one-path rule, and S2-resolve-load's loaded-document outcome, and names any element the rule contradicts. Review form: the criterion is applied to the rule's text; nothing runs.
